assembly_notes: Fit and fasten the PCB and internal modules, then verify shell mating-face alignment and screw engagement without over-torquing.
Route and secure wiring clear of motors, moving joints, and shell edges; confirm sensor alignment and charging-interface fit.
Perform functional checks of compute, camera, lidar, ToF, IMU, motor drives, servo, battery protection, and dock charging; run a motor and charging burn-in.
Handle and protect lithium-ion cells against short circuit and damage; ship by sea only as UN3481 packed with equipment.
